title: Real-Time Infrastructure Architecture Decision Record
context: 9router application - AI provider dashboard with SSE streaming, collaborative editing, and model combo management
problem statement: Synchronize XYFlow diagram state, DnD-kit drag-and-drop events, Monaco editor content, and SSE-streamed AI responses across clients with convergence, resilience, and scalability requirements. Must survive network partitions, reconnects, concurrent edits, and deploys without data loss or divergence.
considered options: CRDT-based document state with server-arbitrated sequencing
decision: Hybrid approach: CRDT machinery for text/collaborative state where convergence matters, server-arbitrated last-writer-wins for status/fields, and ephemeral TTL-scoped presence. XYFlow state transmitted via seq-numbered ops over WebSocket with idempotent apply. DnD-kit events as durable ops. Monaco editor content as CRDT-backed document. SSE streaming as separate channel from durable state.
objectives: Exactly-once delivery of durable ops (idempotent apply by opId)
Convergent text state (CRDT or OT) so concurrent edits merge
Resume from last acknowledged seq on reconnect (no data loss)
resolved issues: Convergence: CRDT for text (Yjs-like fractional indexing), LWW for status fields
Ordering: Server-assigned sequence numbers; client timestamps are wishes only
Idempotency: Every operation keyed by client-generated opId; duplicate apply is no-op
Presence vs documents: Separate channels - presence TTL-scoped, document ops durable log
Reconnect: Client tracks lastServerSeq; server replays gap from append-only op log
Backpressure: Coalesce updates (last-cursor-wins), bound queues, drop-then-resync
